decisions.reason: As a newly launched dental consumable with its own page, it shows visible commitment and a fit with the firm's established thermoforming and quality-focused business, so management is likely to continue it and attribute any weak early uptake to a normal ramp-up period.

This PETG thermoforming blank was given standalone website visibility and closely matches the firm's dental materials capabilities, making management inclined to stay the course rather than write off a recent launch.

The UV-curing lacquer appears to involve less public commitment because it was only mentioned on the website, but it still complements laboratory workflows, so management would more likely retain it for now while treating any disappointment as temporary.

The intraoral contrast spray had its own page and supports digital and clinical workflows that are central to the firm's stated direction, so escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it on the market.

Although the custom earmold line had lower website prominence, it fits the firm's custom-device manufacturing base and hearing-care channels, so management is likely to persist with it rather than reverse a recent expansion.

Custom hearing protection earmolds are a somewhat less visibly committed launch, but they reuse the firm's hearing-related know-how and channels, which makes management more likely to continue than withdraw them after only one year.
